model: CycloGic CL-MC03 Modbus interface module (Samsung DVM / CAC / RAC)
applies_to: CycloGic CL-MC03*** series Modbus interface modules (1 to 64 indoor units) for Samsung DVM, CAC, FJM and RAC units, instruction manual Rev. 2 (Oct. 2017).
summary: The CL-MC03 series is a CycloGic-made Modbus RTU interface that connects to the F1/F2 network of Samsung DVM, CAC, FJM or RAC indoor units and controls up to 64 of them. Each indoor unit has a 20-register block. This map covers the block for indoor unit 0: on/off, mode, set and room temperature, fan speed, louver swing and the duct-unit supply-air setpoints.

addressing.note: The manual uses Modicon numbers: 40001-40014 for indoor unit 00, plus 20 per indoor unit (unit 01 = 40021, unit 63 = 41261). Subtract 40001 for the wire address: unit N, register 4000k is address 20*N + k - 1.

source.title: CL-MC03*** Series Modbus Interface Module Instruction Manual
source.pages: DIP switches p. 4; rotary address p. 5; Modbus configuration and functions p. 7; readback data p. 8; control data p. 9

notes: Source host: an unaltered copy of the CycloGic manual on a product-catalogue site; we did not find a public copy on CycloGic's or Samsung's sites.
Only FC 03 (read) and FC 06 (write single register) are supported; all values are 16-bit.

Writes to 40001 and 40009 carry two one-byte fields (on/off + mode, fan speed + louver swing). The manual does not say which byte holds which field, so those writes are not mapped; the registers are listed for reading.
Temperatures are value / 10; the manual does not state whether they are signed.
Registers 40003-40004 and 40007-40008 are not described in the manual.

registers.name: IDU on/off status
registers.description: Read value. Writes to this register use a packed on/off + mode format (see notes).

registers.name: IDU fan speed
registers.description: Read value. Writes use a packed fan speed + louver format (see notes).

values.1: Swing on: upper and lower louver
values.2: Swing on: right and left louver
values.3: Swing on: upper/lower and right/left louver

integration.summary: Set DIP SW2 for the Samsung product type, set the Modbus address on the two rotary switches, then poll FC 03 from address 20*N for indoor unit N. Change the set temperature with FC 06 at 20*N + 4.
integration.enable: DIP SW2 OFF for DVM/CAC (AM/AC models), ON for RAC/FJM (AR/AJ models); DIP SW1 must stay ON (firmware download disabled) in normal use. The slave address is set with RSW1 (tens) and RSW2 (ones).
quirks: Modicon numbering, 20 registers per indoor unit.
Temperatures are tenths of a degree.
setup: 19200 bps, even parity, 1 stop bit; Modbus line up to 500 m.
12 V DC supply from the indoor unit V1/V2 terminals; F1/F2 to the Samsung network.
gotchas: DIP SW2 must match the Samsung product family: OFF for DVM/CAC, ON for RAC/FJM.
The module's dry-contact input forces units on/off and its DO closes on an error.

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
